test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
F**rom among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Almost all the governors of Bengal strongly **resented** the special **privileges** enjoyed by English company as it meant a huge loss to the **provinciel** **exchequer**.
solution:
The correct answer is **provinciel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct spelling** and meaning of the **selected option** are:

 
 
• **Provincial**: connected with one of the large areas that some countries are divided into.
 
 

Thus, the **incorrectly** **spelled** word in the given sentence is **provinciel**.

 
• Thus, the correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **spellings** of all other given words are correct.
 
• The **meanings** of other** given words** are as follows:
 
 
• **Resented:** to feel angry about something because you think it is unfair
 
• **Exchequer**: the public or national supply of money
 
• **Privileges:** a special right or advantage that only one person or group has
